purpose: Define a professional, reader-oriented CBD repository landing page that builds conceptual understanding of the scientific model before routing technical use, reproducibility and development detail to the appropriate surfaces.
suite_reference_order: Ask the Model (AtM): primary reference for progressive, user-oriented explanation and first-use clarity
Romanian Monetary Dynamics (RMD): secondary reference for adapting the shared presentation system to a scientific-model repository
design_principle: Shared presentation system, project-specific information architecture.
primary_audiences: new reader trying to understand the model
developer or reviewer looking for the route into technical documentation

canonical_identity.plain_language_purpose: CBD studies how information-related history and decision context influence modeled cognitive states and probabilistic sharing decisions over time.
canonical_identity.technical_identity: An event-driven cognitive state-transition and agent-level stochastic dynamical model informed by systems thinking; not currently a formal System Dynamics model.
canonical_identity.paradigm_boundary: Persistent state, temporal ordering and nonlinear or stochastic updates do not by themselves imply closed endogenous System Dynamics feedback.
canonical_identity.research_direction: Progressive endogenization is admissible only when scientifically justified, explicitly bounded and supported by an appropriate evidence and validation strategy.

required_public_boundaries: not currently a formal System Dynamics model
not a validated predictor of individual or population human behavior
not a truth detector or diagnostic system
synthetic or computational validation is not human validation
conceptual coverage is broader than executable coverage

publication_gate.merge_rationale: Collapse iterative review commits into one coherent landing-page redesign commit on main while retaining the full branch/PR history in GitHub.
publication_gate.version_rationale: This PR changes repository presentation, documentation contracts and regression tests only. It does not change the scientific model, package API, data, retained results or release metadata; v0.1.1 therefore remains the current citable release. Any future version change must be decided independently at the next release gate based on the full Unreleased change set.
publication_gate.citation_on_merge: CITATION.cff remains at v0.1.1 until a separate release decision is approved.

post_merge_metadata_sync.repository_description: Research model of how information exposure, memory, corrective context, perceived source reliability and decision context influence modeled cognitive states and sharing decisions over time.
post_merge_metadata_sync.topics: preserve current research-software and modeling topics
post_merge_metadata_sync.rationale: Keep the GitHub About description concise and aligned with the approved landing-page message while preserving the fuller probabilistic wording in the README tagline.

publication_surfaces.github_pages_boundary: A Pages URL is configured, but main currently contains no dedicated index.md, index.html, _config.yml, Gemfile, CNAME or .nojekyll site source. Do not treat GitHub Pages as the canonical landing-page source unless a separate site is explicitly designed and versioned.
publication_surfaces.historical_conceptual_assets: assets/readme/ retained for traceability; not part of the current landing page unless explicitly referenced by README.md
